page.overview:
Who is Mairen?

Mairen was the third child and the only daughter of the third Númenórean King, Tar-Amandil, and sister to the future King, Tar-Elendil. Virtually nothing is known about her life but that she had one other brother, Eärendur.

The name Mairen might be related to Mairon (meaning "admirable").
